hero.title: National Helpline Against Atrocities
hero.subtitle: A victim-centred platform for grievance registration, support and tracking under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act & Protection of Civil Rights Act.

sahaya.title: SAHAYA — AI-Assisted Victim Support & Vulnerability Assessment
sahaya.description: SAHAYA helps identify indicators of distress, fear, trauma and vulnerability during the grievance process and helps authorized personnel prioritize appropriate human support.
sahaya.consentText: SAHAYA analyzes your interaction for indicators associated with distress, fear, trauma and vulnerability to help prioritize appropriate human support.
sahaya.disclaimer1: This is not a medical or psychiatric diagnosis.
sahaya.disclaimer2: AI does not replace professional legal or psychological assessment.
sahaya.disclaimer3: Authorized human personnel review all high-priority cases.
sahaya.disclaimer4: You can choose to continue without AI assessment at any time.
sahaya.victimPrompt: Please tell us what happened and how you are feeling.
sahaya.recordingActive: Listening... Speak naturally in your preferred language
sahaya.placeholderText: Enter details of what occurred, threats faced, or how this incident is affecting your safety...
sahaya.immediateSafetyDesc: Our safety indicators have flagged urgent distress. An authorized officer will be prioritized.
sahaya.sviThresholdNotice: SVI thresholds shown in this prototype are administrative demonstration thresholds and are not clinical diagnostic cutoffs.
sahaya.aiRecommendationNotice: AI recommendation — requires authorized human review.

rescue.statutoryNotice: Administrative demonstration escalation. For life-threatening emergencies, dial 112 directly.
